description: Browse the catalog of ready-made Wiro agents (templates) that deploy_agent can deploy. Each template shows its Starter and Pro price in USD per 30 days and the monthly credit pool that pays for the agent's chat and scheduled tasks (100 credits = 1 USD); model runs it starts, for images, videos or voice calls, are billed to the wallet of the workspace that owns the Wiro project connected to the agent. A template whose pricing is null cannot be priced right now: do not quote or deploy it. Call get_agent_template next for the skills, the credentials the user must provide and the exact prices. To build an agent from individual skills instead, use list_agent_skills. get_playbook describes the whole flow from choosing a template to a running agent.

category.description: Category filter, for example "social-media". Separate several categories with commas.

search.description: Words to look for in the title, description, slug and categories, for example "instagram". Results are sorted by relevance when set.

sort.description: Order when no search is given: newest first, most deployed first, or by title.

name: list_agent_templates
title: List Wiro agent templates
